dashboardItems.text: This dashboard illustrates a potential design for a national SDG4 reporting dashboard. It integrates data from the Annual School Census, household surveys, population estimates, and other relevant sources contributing to SDG4 indicators. The example demonstrates how DHIS2 can facilitate streamlined reporting to the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS) by enabling the consolidation, storage, and extraction of data from multiple sources within a single platform.
SDG Target 4.1: By 2030, ensure that all girls and boys complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education leading to relevant and effective learning outcomes
SDG Target 4.2 By 2030, ensure that all girls and boys have access to quality early childhood development, care and pre-primary education so that they are ready for primary education
SDG Target 4.6 By 2030, ensure that all youth and a substantial proportion of adults, both men and women, achieve literacy and numeracy
SDG Target 4.a: Build and upgrade education facilities that are child, disability and gender-sensitive and provide safe, nonviolent, inclusive and effective learning environments for all

organisationUnitGroups.description: CONFIGURATION PLACEHOLDER. Must contain every school in the country, at the organisation unit level at which the EMIS data sets are captured. It is the denominator of the six SDG 4.a 'Proportion of schools offering basic services' indicators (codes SDG4_SCHOOLS_BASIC_ELECTRICITY, SDG4_SCHOOLS_BASIC_DRINKING_WATER, SDG4_SCHOOLS_BASIC_HANDWASHING, SDG4_SCHOOLS_BASIC_INTERNET, SDG4_SCHOOLS_BASIC_COMPUTERS, SDG4_SCHOOLS_BASIC_SNE_INFRASTRUCTURE), which return no value while this group is empty. Membership is implementation-specific and is not shipped with the package.

ESPACE RÉSERVÉ DE CONFIGURATION. Ce groupe doit contenir toutes les écoles du pays, au niveau d'unité d'organisation auquel les ensembles de données SIGE sont saisis. Il constitue le dénominateur des six indicateurs ODD 4.a « Proportion d'écoles offrant des services de base » (codes SDG4_SCHOOLS_BASIC_*), qui ne renvoient aucune valeur tant que ce groupe est vide. Les membres sont spécifiques à chaque mise en œuvre et ne sont pas fournis avec le package.
